awakening.speaker: Elder Yunjian
awakening.text:
Cold stone presses your back. Your mind is empty — no name, no past, only the ache of forgotten days.

A figure in azure robes kneels beside you, qi swirling like mist around his palm.

*"You yet breathe. That is enough for now."*

awakening_pain.speaker: Elder Yunjian
awakening_pain.text:
*"Easy. The memories are gone — torn away or buried too deep. Do not force them yet."*

He steadies you with a hand that feels like iron wrapped in silk.

awakening_stare.speaker: Elder Yunjian
awakening_stare.text: *"Good. Panic serves no one here. You have eyes that still see — that is a start."*

awakening_mute.speaker: Elder Yunjian
awakening_mute.text: *"Your voice will return. First, tell me who you wish to be called in this world."*

cultivator_asks_name.speaker: Elder Yunjian
cultivator_asks_name.text: *"What name shall the cultivation world remember? Grasp a fragment from the fog of memory — or speak your own."*

name_confirmed.speaker: Elder Yunjian
name_confirmed.text: *"**{dao_name}**... yes. The word settles in the air like a seal."*

cultivator_asks_gender.speaker: Elder Yunjian
cultivator_asks_gender.text: *"And how shall I address you — as a man, a woman, or simply as you are?"*

memory_flavor.speaker: Elder Yunjian
memory_flavor.text: *"Your past is a sealed scroll. If you wish to read it again, you must walk the path of cultivation. Mortals forget; cultivators *remember*."*

memory_why.speaker: Elder Yunjian
memory_why.text: *"The heavens drop no coin without reason. You may yet matter to this age — or I am a fool. We shall see."*

memory_where.speaker: Elder Yunjian
memory_where.text: *"Heaven-Seeking Peak — my seclusion. Below us lie sects, groves, and beasts that hunger for qi. You stand at the edge of that world."*

memory_accept.speaker: Elder Yunjian
memory_accept.text: *"Spoken like one who still has a spine. Good — the path will test it."*

world_intro.speaker: Elder Yunjian
world_intro.text:
He gestures toward the horizon.

*"Cultivators gather qi, break through realms, and carve their dao in blood and enlightenment. Sects, manuals, spirit beasts — all await below. But first, you must choose the *flavor* of your journey."*

world_dao.speaker: Elder Yunjian
world_dao.text: *"Your dao is the way you meet the world — blade, lotus, starlight, or hidden ledger. It shapes how fortune finds you."*

world_sects.speaker: Elder Yunjian
world_sects.text: *"Sects take disciples when they are ready — not before. Prove yourself as a cultivator first; I will speak of them again when your qi refines."*

path_intro.speaker: Elder Yunjian
path_intro.text:
*"Four paths lie before you. Each grants a blessing suited to its dao. Choose — and know that your story will follow this road.

 The **Path of the Unbroken Blade** — steel will and decisive strikes, the dao of the sword.
 The **Path of the Still Lotus** — rooted qi and patient defense, the dao of the shield.
 The **Path of the Wandering Star** — starlight and long breaths, the dao of steady cultivation.
 The **Path of the Hidden Ledger** — secrets, karma, and winding roads, the dao of the wanderer."*

Blade path: +5% hunt and adventure success.
Lotus path: +3 starting qi and a qi-gathering pill.
Star path: +8% cultivate qi for your first sessions.
Ledger path: +spirit stones and a technique fragment.

spirit_reveal.speaker: Elder Yunjian
spirit_reveal.text:
As your path settles, fragments of a forgotten past surface. Your **spirit root** manifests — a gift from a life you cannot recall.

*"Interesting. The heavens left you tools even without your memories. Accept them, and begin."*

trial_intro.speaker: Elder Yunjian
trial_intro.text: *"I will guide your first steps. Follow my counsel — claim your stipend, gather qi, and prove you can survive Mortal Grove. When you are ready, return to me at Qi Refining for what comes next."*

trial_stipend.speaker: Elder Yunjian
trial_stipend.text: *"Sects and elders grant daily spirit stones and qi to disciples who report in. Use **`/daily`** to claim yours."*

trial_grove.speaker: Elder Yunjian
trial_grove.text: *"A hunting ground for mortals and fledgling cultivators. Spirit beasts roam there — you will visit soon enough."*

wait_daily.speaker: Elder Yunjian
wait_daily.text:
*"First, claim your daily stipend. The path cannot be walked on an empty purse."*

▸ Use **`/daily`** now.

after_daily.speaker: Elder Yunjian
after_daily.text: *"Good. Spirit stones and qi flow to those who keep rhythm. Now feel your meridians — draw qi inward."*

after_daily_how.speaker: Elder Yunjian
after_daily_how.text: *"Sit in stillness and call the qi. **`/cultivate`** — or the **Cultivate** button on **`/profile`**."*

after_daily_ache.speaker: Elder Yunjian
after_daily_ache.text: *"Pain means the channels are waking. Breathe through it — then **`/cultivate`**."*

wait_cultivate.speaker: Elder Yunjian
wait_cultivate.text:
*"Gather qi once. Let the meridian awakening run its course."*

▸ Use **`/cultivate`** or the profile button.

after_cultivate.speaker: Elder Yunjian
after_cultivate.text: *"Your dantian stirs. A cultivator must also test steel — hunt a spirit beast in Mortal Grove."*

choices.label: How do I reach the grove?

after_cultivate_fear.speaker: Elder Yunjian
after_cultivate_fear.text: *"Fear is honest. Courage is hunting anyway. Win your first fight with **`/hunt`**."*

after_cultivate_grove.speaker: Elder Yunjian
after_cultivate_grove.text: *"Mortal Grove is your realm's hunting ground. Call **`/hunt`** when your timer allows."*

wait_hunt.speaker: Elder Yunjian
wait_hunt.text:
*"Win a hunt in Mortal Grove. Bring back proof that you can survive."*

▸ Use **`/hunt`** and claim victory.

after_hunt.speaker: Elder Yunjian
after_hunt.text: *"You live — and blood on your hands means little when the beast would have taken yours. Study the manual that fate left you."*

after_hunt_manual.speaker: Elder Yunjian
after_hunt_manual.text: *"A cultivation art sleeps in your storage ring. Open **`/techniques`** and **Unlock Skill** from your manual."*

after_hunt_techniques.speaker: Elder Yunjian
after_hunt_techniques.text: *"Your martial ledger lives in **`/techniques`**. Learn your origin art first — you will equip it next."*

wait_learn.speaker: Elder Yunjian
wait_learn.text:
*"Unlock your manual in **`/techniques`** → **Unlock Skill**. Study it before you carry it into battle."*

▸ Complete this now.

after_learn.speaker: Elder Yunjian
after_learn.text: *"The art lives in your memory — but memory alone does not strike. Fix it to your loadout."*

after_learn_how.speaker: Elder Yunjian
after_learn_how.text: *"Open **`/techniques`** → **Equip Skill**, choose your art, then pick slot **1** or **passive**."*

after_learn_slots.speaker: Elder Yunjian
after_learn_slots.text: *"Active arts fill slots **1–4**; one passive breathes behind all of them. Either serves for this lesson."*

wait_equip.speaker: Elder Yunjian
wait_equip.text:
*"Equip the art you just studied — **`/techniques`** → **Equip Skill**."*

▸ Do this before the sage's trial.

after_equip.speaker: Elder Yunjian
after_equip.text: *"Your art is ready. Walk the bamboo trail — a sage will test your heart. I have arranged this."*

after_equip_sage.speaker: Elder Yunjian
after_equip_sage.text: *"An old friend who reads karma in a bow or a glare. Begin **`/adventure`** when you are ready."*

after_equip_heart.speaker: Elder Yunjian
after_equip_heart.text: *"Choices reveal dao. Answer the sage honestly — or cleverly. **`/adventure`** awaits."*

wait_adventure.speaker: Elder Yunjian
wait_adventure.text:
*"Complete your first adventure — the sage's trial on the bamboo path."*

▸ Use **`/adventure`**.

after_adventure.speaker: Elder Yunjian
after_adventure.text: *"The sage's judgment is recorded. Fill your qi to the brim and attempt breakthrough — leave Mortal early behind."*

choices.label: How do I fill my qi?

after_adventure_qi.speaker: Elder Yunjian
after_adventure_qi.text: *"Cultivate until your qi cap is full. Check **`/profile`** for your progress."*

after_adventure_break.speaker: Elder Yunjian
after_adventure_break.text: *"When qi overflows its vessel, you shatter the shell of your current substage. Use **`/breakthrough`**."*

wait_breakthrough.speaker: Elder Yunjian
wait_breakthrough.text: *"Attempt **`/breakthrough`** when your qi is full. Cross Mortal early — the sect watches."*

chapter1_complete.speaker: Elder Yunjian
chapter1_complete.text: *"Well done. You have passed my first test. Keep cultivating — when you reach **Qi Refining**, return with **`/story`**. Then we speak of sects and the next chapter of your memory."*

complete.speaker: Elder Yunjian
complete.text: *"Walk your path. I will be here when your qi refines."*
